text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...*pant*... *gasp*.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah... The color of the heavens remains 
unchanged, merely looking down upon 
me......

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
In other words... the appointed time has 
not yet arrived, is that it?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
However... the curtain has risen. Today, 
the Saint has descended upon the turf.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Desire! That was an incredible run!" "Red 
Desire! We'll keep cheering for you all 
the way!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my...! Such warm blessings for the 
Holy Maiden... so very many...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I offer you my deepest thanks. The saint, 
Red Desire, shall continue to blaze across 
the turf and guide you all onward—!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: "Way to go, Desire! Give it your all!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone is watching me...! Fixing their 
fervent gazes upon me, dedicating their 
burning passions to me—...!)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...My spiritual rank is being elevated—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah... It is truly magnificent. This is the 
radiance of a race. The power that 
elevates a Saint to greater heights—...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Red Desire successfully made her Debut. 
Having overcome her first trial, she wore 
a refreshed smile.
choice_data_list: Good work! That was a great run!
Good work! That was a great run!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Fufu, thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I was aware of it, but... it seems the 
'other world' isn't simple enough to reach 
in just a single race.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
However... I became certain. That this 
path leads to "that place."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed she was unable to reach the 
'Other World' in this race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I think carefully once more about the 
"Other World" she speaks of.
choice_data_list: Is the Otherworld... a real place...?
Is the Otherworld... a real place...?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Yes, parallel worlds do exist.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
There are indeed Umamusume who know they 
truly exist.
"Yo! Good work today!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: That was an amazing run, Desire!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my...! Vodka-san...! You came to 
watch!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Damn straight! I've had my eye on you for 
a while because your running is super 
cool!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The one who appeared was Vodka—an 
Umamusume who captivates fans with 
common-sense-defying strength and 
constantly strives to reach unseen 
heights.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Ah... Vodka-san...♡

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
To hear that from you, of all people... 
I'm so deeply touched!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Vodka-san is always dignified and radiant, 
with the resolve and strength to stay true 
to herself... She is the Umamusume I look 
up to.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An idea suddenly comes to mind, so I ask 
Vodka about it.
choice_data_list:
Are you... the horse girl who knows about 
the other world?

Are you... an Uma Musume who knows about 
the other world?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Another world? Well, I dunno if it's 
really an "isekai" or whatever, but...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I'm always running toward somewhere far 
away from here!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I wanna show everyone too. The 
one-and-only, super cool world that I'm 
gonna carve out!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Desire, if there's a place you want to 
reach by continuing to race... then take 
all your fans there with you.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Anyone who isn't ready to shoulder the 
weight will never carve out a new era!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Heh, it's settled, then...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
“Yes, the more people who call my name and 
hold me dear in their hearts... the 
greater the radiance gained from racing 
will be...”

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
In other words, my Saintly Power 
increases... and the hour of reaching the 
Otherworld draws even nearer...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
With Vodka-san's teachings in my heart, I 
swear to run this path to the very end!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Haha, that's the spirit! I'm counting on 
ya!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
They say the alternate world "exists." 
It's an uncertain destination, but for 
now, all we can do is face forward and 
run.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After returning to the academy, we held a 
discussion regarding future plans... or 
rather, an interview under the guise of 
one.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Vodka-san's guidance, I can now 
see what I should prioritize.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Proving the existence of the Saint. That 
is the key to the other world. Therefore—"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
We must run more races, gain more 
believers, and elevate our holy power even 
further!
choice_data_list: Yeah... Got it! Let's do this!
Yeah... Got it! Let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The mystery of the "Otherworld" remains a 
mystery. Even so, I want to support her 
with everything I have as she burns with 
passion for racing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For that sake— I have to learn more about 
this "Other World"!
